' "$?"; for fn in 8000EB14 8000EBD4 80177434; do build/tools/objdiff-cli diff -p . -u main/game/game_fn_${fn} fn_${fn} -o reports/GEDE01/objdiff-game_fn_${fn}-session-1430-remediation-1.json --format json-pretty -c function_reloc_diffs=name_address >/dev/null 2>&1; printf 'objdiff_fn_%s_exit=%s

' "$?"

measurement.command: for f in reports/GEDE01/objdiff-game_fn_8000EB14-session-1430-remediation-1.json reports/GEDE01/objdiff-game_fn_8000EBD4-session-1430-remediation-1.json reports/GEDE01/objdiff-game_fn_80177434-session-1430-remediation-1.json; do jq -r '[.left.symbols[0].name, (.left.symbols[0].size|tostring), (.right.symbols[0].size|tostring), (.left.symbols[0].match_percent|tostring), (([.left.symbols[0].instructions[]|select(.diff_kind!=null)]|length)|tostring), (([.left.symbols[0].instructions[]|select(.instruction.relocation!=null)]|length)|tostring), (([.right.symbols[0].instructions[]|select(.instruction.relocation!=null)]|length)|tostring)] | @tsv' "$f"; done
